attackers_goals: An attacker may attempt to control an Active Directory environment.
description: A user account was modified with delegation to a service.
investigative_actions: Verify this action with the user who performed the change. Check if the account modified is a service account. Follow actions by the user, including TGT and TGS requests. Monitor for anomalous Kerberos activity.
name: User account delegation change
required_data: XDR Agent with eXtended Threat Hunting (XTH)
